execution_rule: Execute the frozen continuous first-crossing interpolation and all four V150 gates once. No threshold, pair, sector, or tolerance changes.
fresh_kill_condition: Kill exact V150 if any sector lacks a valid first-pair interpolation, max absolute shift exceeds 1.0 beam, fewer than six sectors or the median fail the 0.25-beam concentration gate, Spearman rho is below 0.90, or absolute median signed shift exceeds 0.15 beam.
